lines: [furious, shouting] The fourteenth?! Who said yes to the fourteenth?!
[thinking aloud, drawn out] So... do we launch on the fourteenth?
[firm, cutting him off] No, no. The fourteenth. Final.
[brisk, pointing] Arjun. Pricing deck, by Thursday.
[loud, to the whole room] Someone note it down!
[sheepish, embarrassed little laugh] Okay... so the fourteenth is final, then.
